findings.claim: Objective o1 ('Build a jdbc:postgresql URL from host, port and database...') is credited by the connect and apply activities, but neither asks the learner to build or choose a URL: the workbench only presses preset buttons and the apply MCQ diagnoses a hard-coded database name. The only URL-construction practice is GIFT item 'o1 URL shape', so the HTML marks o1 done without the observable behavior.
findings.recommendation: Add a required URL-building interaction (e.g. assemble or type jdbc:postgresql://host:port/database from the settings card, with per-error feedback for missing subprotocol and host/port/database order), or reword o1 to the behavior actually exercised (recognising env-var-driven settings).
